entity_cache.code_match_scope: Runtime and protocol bytes must match exactly. Origin/current evaluator hashes are separately recorded; literal prompts and all entity job identities are reconstructed independently.

entity_strategy.variant_match_scope: Input view and source order only; it does not establish complete-window supervision. Exact supervision is identified by the training manifest and data SHA, including changed overlap/title exposure policies.

entity_cache.new_gpu_relation_calls_definition: Number of relation prompts submitted to the real backend, counted before invocation. Includes input-budget/deadline refusals and backend exceptions; not GPU decode successes or successful relation outputs.
entity_cache.policy: Strict identity/window consumption and event acknowledgement; failures replay unchanged; no prompt lookup fallback, oracle entities, cache chaining or GPU entity recomputation
entity_cache.relation_generation: Fresh real backend attempts with greedy non-thinking decoding; refusals and failures remain explicit

limitations: All three relation views now share the same actual entity outputs, runtime, evaluator, batch8, and input/output budgets.
Full versus short changes windowing, supervision exposure and optimizer updates together; it is not a pure length-only causal estimate.
The earlier full relation batch4 score is retained. Greedy decoded outputs changed under batch8; do not mix these batch conditions for a learning-rate claim.
Failures and all original gold remain scored. Valid assembled JSON does not imply valid semantic records or correct medical relations.
This is repeated tune-set selection against frozen silver, not a blind test or human clinical adjudication.

batch_comparison.interpretation: Exact prompts/adapters/runtime fixed; actual configured batch changed4to8. Output differences are observed, not new training gains; padded token lists can differ despite equal completion text.
